hero.filename: Catherineberg Sugar Mill Ruins; Saint John, United States Virgin Islands.jpg
hero.caption: Catherineberg Sugar Mill Ruins located in the Virgin Island National Park on Saint John, U.S. Virgin Islands. The ruins are an example of an 18th century sugar and rum factory. In the 1733 slave revolt, Catherineberg was the headquarters of the Amina warriors.
